result.title: From Fixed Defaults to Calibrated Activation Policies for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
result.comment: 36 pages, 2 figures. Shijie Xu and Boyan Tang contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/Tt200411/From-Fixed-Defaults-to-Calibrated-Activation-Policies-for-Long-Term-Time-Series-Forecasting
result.summary: Long-term time-series forecasting supports decisions in energy, transportation, and other applications where reliable predictions are needed beyond the observed data. Although forecasting research has advanced model architectures, fixed activation configurations provide limited guidance on how activation choices should vary across datasets and prediction horizons. This study aims to establish when task-specific activation choices improve forecasting accuracy and how previous experiments can guide the selection of suitable configurations for new tasks. We develop a calibrated selection policy that learns a reliable default from prior experiments, adapts the activation function and its location to each task, and retains the default when evidence for a change is insufficient. In an evaluation supported by 1,225 Informer training runs across 17 dataset variants and 51 forecasting tasks, the policy reduces mean squared error by 7.86% on average relative to the conventional fixed-activation baseline and improves 72.55% of tasks. These findings establish activation choice and placement as practical opportunities for improving existing forecasting models and show how accumulated experimental evidence can guide configuration decisions without repeating an exhaustive search for every task.

AI.brief_summary: 该研究面向长期时间序列预测，提出一种校准式激活选择策略：从既往实验中学习可靠默认配置，按任务与预测跨度调整激活函数及其位置，并在证据不足时保留默认；在 1225 次 Informer 训练上平均降低 MSE 7.86%。
AI.relevance_reason: 主题属预测任务配置选择，与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「以证据强度决定是否偏离默认配置」的校准策略，可能为 latent 推理中何时追加计算、何时停止或切换策略的门控设计提供概念参照，需核查其判据形式。
